title: Marburg haemorrhagic fever in Uganda - update
summary: As of 28 October 2012, a total of 18 cases and 9 deaths have been reported from 5 districts namely, Kabale district in south-western Uganda, Kampala (the capital city), Ibanda, Mbarara and Kabarole.

title: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo – update
summary: As of 24 October 2012, 52 cases (35 laboratory confirmed, 17 probable) with Ebola haemorrhagic fever (EHF) have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Of these, 25 have been fatal (12 confirmed, 13 probable).

title: Marburg haemorrhagic fever in Uganda - update
summary: As of 21 October 2012, nine (9) probable and confirmed cases, including 5 deaths have been reported with Marburg haemorrhagic fever in Kitumba sub-county, Kabale district in South-western Uganda.

title: Marburg haemorrhagic fever in Uganda
summary: The Ministry of Health in Uganda has declared an outbreak of Marburg hemorrhagic fever in Kitumba sub-county, Kabale district in South-western Uganda.

title: Dengue Fever in Madeira, Portugal
summary: An outbreak of dengue fever has been reported in Madeira, Portugal.  As of 10 October 2012, a total of 18 confirmed cases and 191 probable cases have been reported.
